## Read-only context composition — unbound source
Byline: Codex · GPT-6.1-Sol · 2026-10-06.

Inputs: {flow:"read_retrieval", request_id, inputs:{query, leg_names:"intake,proffer", mode?:"keyword"|"hybrid", scope_json?:JSON-string, limit?, per_leg_limit?, leg_timeout_seconds?}}.
Output: compact FlowResult from server.core.retrieval_composition.retrieve_flow; citations/ranks and explicit success/partial/failed, no excerpt bodies.
Effects: existing injected read legs only. Use for a Temporal-owned context read; never evidence promotion or indexing.

No API route or worker binding exists for this composition in this commit. HTTP URL is deliberately empty, credentials are unbound, and active=false. Do not activate until the existing server owner exposes this exact contract, injects configured read-only readers, installs the retrieval extra, and binds both webhook and runtime header-auth credentials. This export makes no runnable/live claim.

Installed n8n 2.36.6 Weaviate node 1.3 lacks named-vector target selection. Reader wiring must use existing Intake HTTP or explicit Weaviate HTTP: IntakeCorpus/text_vector; ProfferChunks20261002/text_nim. No default-vector substitution. Temporal owns durable retries; no n8n retry/wait/gate is added.

Scope JSON supports matter_id, source_id, source_version_ids, thread_id and path_prefix. Only server-authorized scope is admitted; each injected leg must declare/enforce supported modes/scopes before top-k, otherwise it returns unsupported_mode/unsupported_scope. No post-filter or broader fallback. Direct library callers pass a typed scope object; FlowRequest.inputs keeps scope_json scalar.
